description:
About our brand and products:
Eat Sleep Dogs is a print-on-demand t-shirt brand created for serious dog people: trainers, handlers, competitors, breed enthusiasts, working dog fans, and anyone whose lifestyle is deeply shaped by dogs. Our designs center around dog ownership, training, dog sports, working dogs, breed pride, and the humor that comes with living the dog life.

What makes us different:
We’re not a generic “cute dog shirt” brand. Eat Sleep Dogs speaks to people who understand training sessions, trial weekends, breed quirks, muddy gear, long drives, and the very specific joy of talking dogs with people who get it. Our designs are made for experienced dog lovers who appreciate smart, niche, and community-driven apparel.

How affiliates can earn:
Affiliates earn commission by sharing Eat Sleep Dogs products with their audience. When someone makes a qualifying purchase through your affiliate link, you receive a commission on the sale.

How to promote us:
Share your favorite designs on social media, in blog posts, newsletters, training groups, dog sport communities, breed clubs, or anywhere your dog-loving audience spends time. Product photos, lifestyle posts, gift guides, “what I’m wearing to training” content, and breed- or sport-specific recommendations are all great ways to promote Eat Sleep Dogs.

Other information:
We’re looking for affiliates who genuinely connect with the dog community and want to share apparel that feels authentic to that world. Whether your audience is full of trainers, competitors, working dog handlers, devoted pet owners, or breed nerds, Eat Sleep Dogs offers products made for people who don’t just like dogs — they live dogs.

Please note: Our affiliate program is intended for dog professionals and dog sports communities, and we don’t allow promotion through generic coupon/deal sites. Affiliates may not submit or allow their codes/links to be listed on coupon/deal aggregators. Doing so will cause the affiliate to be removed from our program.
payout_period: Affiliates are paid 1st Monday of each month.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to {EatSleepDogs.com}! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as the merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

Affiliates may not submit, list, or allow their coupon codes or links to be published on generic coupon, deal, cashback, or discount aggregator websites. Our program is intended for dog professionals, dog‑sport communities, and related audiences only.

We reserve the right to deactivate any affiliate account and void commissions for orders generated via unauthorized coupon or deal sites.

3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).
